messages:
mike: Customer ACME reported p99 jump from ~600ms to 3.2s since ~08:12 UTC, multiple timeouts. Customer says behavior started right after we rolled model xg-2 -> xg-2-q. They attached traces and a curl repro. Escalating — can eng take a look? ticket #CS-9142 :flag-us:

sarah_oncall: looking. can you paste the prod graph link and the exact repro steps? any errors in gateway logs? :eyes:

mike: graph: https://grafana.internal/redwood/tenant/ACME/requests?p95,p99 (redacted). gateway logs show a lot of 429/503 spikes and repeated auth refreshes for the same tenant. snippet: ```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: 9a7f
err="admit_queue_full"
{"msg":"admitted=0 queue_len=1024 workers_active=128"}
```

claire_support: Customer ran this curl to reproduce: ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hello"}' -v`` They said p95 goes up after ~30s of sustained requests.

alex_runtime: jumping in. initial hypothesis: token refresh storm + new quantized model increased per-token latency and reduced throughput, causing workers to back up and admission control to start rejecting. Can you confirm if token refresh logs spike at same time?

mike: yes, auth logs show repeated token refresh attempts for ACME (same client_id) every ~2s for many concurrent requests, TTLs look like they were not cached due to a race in auth middleware.

jenny_se: if true, quick mitigations: 1) toggle emergency fallback to xg-2 (non-quant) for ACME via tenant routing (2-3 min) 2) bump per-tenant concurrency to +2 for ACME (temp) 3) short circuit auth cache to reduce refresh frequency. Which one can we do fastest?

alex_runtime: I can flip tenant routing to fallback model and bump concurrency. I'll also push a small hotfix to auth middleware to make token refresh singleflight (fast PR). Doing steps now.

deploy-bot: deployment started: route change for tenant ACME -> xg-2 (rollback) by alex_runtime at 08:27 UTC. CID: dep-7821

alex_runtime: route flipped and concurrency raised for ACME. monitoring now. please do a controlled repro from customer for ~60s and report.

mike: customer ran repro. p95 dropped from 3.2s -> 620ms, p99 ~1.1s. No more 503s. They reported fewer token refreshes. :tada:

sarah_oncall: great. next steps: 1) keep fallback for 4 hours while we validate auth hotfix 2) deploy singleflight token refresh patch to canary, validate 3) revisit quantized model perf profile and kernel selection. I'll open an action item doc and link to the ticket.

claire_support: updated ticket #CS-9142 with mitigation steps + timeline, told customer we'll follow up in 4 hrs. thanks team. :heart:

alex_runtime: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pull/541 -> adds singleflight token cache + metrics. rolling canary now.

jenny_se: also recommend adding an alert: auth_refresh_rate per-tenant > 10/min should page oncall. open a quick alert PR?

alex_runtime: will add alert after canary proves stable. closing loop in 2 hours unless we see regressions.

mike: marking thread resolved for now. will re-open if customer reports regressions.
